subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XYZ123 Departure: Date, Time Arrival: Date, Time Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need any assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Regards, The Flight Booking Team
